item.title: 6 Things to Love About Aksarben Village
item.description: Aksarben Village doubles as a place of connection on UNO's campus. Here are some of the things we love about the historic district.

item.title: Snapshots: UNO Men's Soccer Upsets Creighton in NCAA First Round
item.description: Catch the highlights from the UNO Men's Soccer matchup against Creighton in the NCAA tournament first round!

item.title: 5 Things That Take Longer Than Completing Your FAFSA
item.description: Many put off completing the FAFSA due to the time commitment, but what if we told you it doesn't take as long as you might think?

item.title: Bestselling Author Erik Larson Headlines UNO Writers for Readers Event April 27
item.description: The acclaimed author of “The Devil in the White City” and “The Demon of Unrest” will deliver a guest lecture at the University of Nebraska at Omaha’s Baxter Arena.

item.title: Instructions for Logging Hours the During Holiday Closedown
item.description: Faculty and staff should submit their scheduled leave by Dec. 15.

item.title: Flag Lowering for Mark Rousseau
item.description: The UNO flag will be lowered in his honor on Nov. 20.

item.title: Popular Science: Can Squirrels Survive a Fall from Any Height? Research Has the Answer
item.description: UNO Biomechanics Associate Professor Nathaniel Hunt tells Popular Science that unlike humans, squirrels possess the size, anatomy, and aerial reorientation to survive falls that no human would ever be able to.

item.title: UNO Grad Students Partner with Ralston Schools to Improve Student Behavior, Support Educators
item.description: A new UNO partnership with Ralston Public Schools, supported by scholarships from the U.S. Department of Education, is helping prepare graduate students for future careers while supporting local schools.

item.title: UNO Names Laura Sansoni Employee of the Month
item.description: Sansoni was praised for her exceptional career development expertise, innovative leadership, and dedication to student success.

item.title: Associated Press: Flights Nationwide Experience Continued Delays Post FAA Ground Stop
item.description: UNO Aviation expert Skip Bailey shared his expertise with the AP following the FAA’s Nov. 13 call for flights to ground amid communication loss, pilots relied on their training to ensure safe and quick landings.

item.title: UNO-Led Nebraska Scholar Strategy Network Receives Emergent Chapter Award
item.description: The Scholar Strategy Network (SSN) connects scholars across the country with journalists, civic leaders and policymakers.

item.title: UNO Chancellor Joanne Li Elected to American Association of State Colleges and Universities Board
item.description: During the AASCU annual conference, Chancellor Joanne Li was named as one of the newest members of the organization's board of directors.

item.title: Call for Nominations: Chancellor’s Outstanding Student Leadership Award
item.description: This award recognizes an University of Nebraska at Omaha (UNO) undergraduate student who has demonstrated leadership through influential participation in campus organizations and community volunteer work, in addition to scholarly achievement.

item.title: Parking and Transit Services Updates
item.description: Read about updates to parking and shuttle services for the Student Holiday and Thanksgiving Vacation.

item.description: The UNO flag will be lowered in his honor on Nov. 13.

item.title: Snapshots: 2026 Homecoming
item.description: Take a look back at some top moments from UNO's 2026 Homecoming Week!

item.title: UNO Students to Embark on 100th Spirit Trip
item.description: The UNO Office of Spirit, Tradition, and Signature Events is marking the milestone with a $100 trip to Minnesota for Omaha Hockey.

item.title: UNO Lands NSF Grant to Turn Sports Into a Gateway for STEM Education
item.description: The SPARK-AI project led by Biomechanics Associate Professor Brian Knarr, Ph.D., will help Omaha middle school students explore AI, data science, and STEM careers through the science of sports.

item.title: UNO Ranked No. 5 School in the Nation for Veterans
item.description: Military Times is again recognizing UNO as a top institution for military-connected students and veterans to receive their education, both online and in-person.
